pages.text: The Reality Compiler showed that the universe runs on source code. Beneath the code are $(thing)axioms$() - the rules that decide what can be true at all. Physics is just their consequence.

Real mathematics agrees there are cracks. Godel proved any consistent system rich enough for arithmetic holds true statements it cannot prove; Russell found a set that both is and isn't its own member. The axioms are not as solid as they look.

So, the plan. To leave reality you must break all of them at once: build $(item)Aleph-Null Shards$(), the $(item)Godel Sentence$(), $(item)Russell Paradox Sets$() and $(item)Banach-Tarski Spheres$(), fuse them into $(item)Absolute Infinity$(), then distil $(item)Axiom Fragments$() and open the $(thing)Axiomatic Breach$().
The size of the natural numbers, made solid. Counting its facets never ends.$(br2)Made in $(item)Cantor Diagonalizer$().
"This statement cannot be proven." It is true, and no system can prove it.$(br2)Made in $(item)Cantor Diagonalizer$().
The set of all sets that do not contain themselves. Does it contain itself?$(br2)Made in $(item)Cantor Diagonalizer$().
Cut it into five non-measurable pieces, reassemble them, and you have two spheres.$(br2)Made in $(item)Cantor Diagonalizer$().
Larger than every infinity. It cannot be conceived - and yet here it is.$(br2)Made in $(item)Omnilex Engine$().
A shard of a foundational rule. Mathematics is built on these; so is reality.$(br2)Made in $(item)Axiom Distiller$().
